simple.meaning: יִצְהָרִי (Yitshârîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִצְהָרִי (H3325) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 3:27, with occurrences in Numbers, 1 Chronicles.

occurrences.englishText: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.
Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
